posts.text: Iran-based journalist on visiting Kharg Island: “On the way back I was thinking that this place is a piece of Iran that no threat can empty or drive people away from. For its people, Kharg is not merely an oil terminal. It’s a home where, despite war and threats, the light of life has not been extinguished. This is Iran’s Kharg. This is homeland.”
posts.summary: Highlights Iranian resilience despite geopolitical threats
